name: BIZcomfort Enoshima TERRACE
card: A 24-hour coworking space with a covered terrace, opposite the Enoshima Aquarium
title: BIZcomfort Enoshima TERRACE — 24-hour coworking with a terrace near Enoshima
lead: Six minutes' walk from Katase-Enoshima Station on the Odakyu Enoshima Line, BIZcomfort Enoshima TERRACE is on the 3rd floor of the Lead Sea Katase-Enoshima Building in Fujisawa, right in front of the Enoshima Aquarium. Members can use it 24 hours a day, every day, and the 1-minute plan lets you pay only for the minutes you use. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: 6 min walk from Katase-Enoshima Station (Odakyu Enoshima Line) / 13 min from Enoshima Station (Enoden)
1-minute plan ¥6.6 per minute (registration fee ¥5,500) / weekends & holidays plan ¥6,600/month / every-day plan ¥17,600/month
24 free-seating desks, 5 semi-private booths, 20 private offices
concept: BIZcomfort describes Enoshima as a sightseeing spot that is easy to reach and full of nature, and says the interior was designed to bring that calm nature inside.
The café booths use a large roof and a wide terrace; you can eat, talk and take online meetings there.
steps: Café booths allow food, calls and online meetings.
There is a covered terrace with seating.
Green work booths inspired by Enoshima's nature. Calls of up to 10 minutes; no online meetings.

word.title: What is the 1-minute plan?
body: A pay-as-you-go plan charged by the minute.
At BIZcomfort Enoshima TERRACE it is ¥6.6 a minute, and once registered you can use any BIZcomfort coworking space in Japan.

name: BIZcomfort Sakuragicho
card: A 24-hour coworking space between Takashimacho and Sakuragicho, close to Minato Mirai
title: BIZcomfort Sakuragicho — 24-hour coworking near Minato Mirai, Yokohama
lead: Six minutes' walk from Takashimacho Station on the Yokohama Blue Line and ten minutes from JR Sakuragicho Station, BIZcomfort Sakuragicho is on the 8th floor of NEXGATE Yokohama Sakuragicho in Nishi Ward. Members can use it 24 hours a day, every day. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: 6 min walk from Takashimacho Station (Blue Line) / 10 min from Sakuragicho Station (JR) / 10 min from Minatomirai Station (Minatomirai Line)
1-minute plan ¥8.8 per minute (registration fee ¥5,500) / weekends & holidays plan ¥5,500/month / every-day plan ¥14,300/month
concept: BIZcomfort says the coworking area for solo work has partitioned desks, suited to focused work and remote work.
Drinks, Wi-Fi and printers are free, and every seat has a power outlet. There is a 6-person meeting room and a booth for online meetings (paid, booking required).
steps: Every seat has a power outlet.
The meeting room and online-meeting room are paid and must be booked.
On the 8th floor of NEXGATE Yokohama Sakuragicho.

word.title: What is the weekends & holidays plan?
body: A monthly plan for using one location's coworking space on Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays only.
At BIZcomfort Sakuragicho it costs ¥5,500 a month.
